structured_output.what_is_happening: CORDON launched on pump.fun at 14:25 UTC. It went up about 13x in its first hour, from a few thousand dollars to about $49k market cap, and graduated to a PumpSwap pool at about 15:23 UTC (GMGN migrated_unix). The new PumpSwap pool holds about $18k of liquidity. It is a low-effort 'AI bot-detection utility' launch: cordon.world is a template-style landing page with an outlook.com contact email. The page says the $CORDON token is 'not yet live', the contract will be 'published at launch', and it points to X handle @Cordonxyz. The token metadata instead points to @cordonworld. The website never mentions this contract or @cordonworld. I found no organic discussion anywhere. The flow looks like a bonding-curve pump driven by bundlers and bots: GMGN tags 95 bundler wallets, 27 snipers and 105 fresh wallets, with a 45% bot/degen rate.
